decision.reason: [ev-d78886a20329] is a single changelog line. It says only that the in-cluster cluster can no longer be used when it is disabled, and it points to PR #21208 for details. It doesn't say how in-cluster gets disabled (which setting or key), so no applicability condition can be written. It also doesn't say what happens to existing Applications or operations that target a disabled in-cluster (for example, sync failure, rejection or an error state), so the consequence can't be typed. We need the PR #21208 description or the matching upgrade-guide entry.
